source.paper: Well Begun is Half Done: Location-Aware and Trace-Guided Iterative Automated Vulnerability Repair

metric.plausible: patch passes all available PoVs. NOTE: no functional-test gate at all — a strictly weaker bar than PatchAgent's and San2Patch's 'repaired'.
metric.correct: manually judged (n=3 annotators, >=2 years experience) semantically equivalent to the developer patch

task_setting: Function-level AVR: the vulnerable function AND vulnerable statement are given as INPUT, from CrashAnalysis (CrashRepair) localization. LoopRepair does not localize from scratch — a materially easier information regime than PatchAgent/San2Patch (sanitizer report only) or ours (static alert only).

dataset.name: VulnLoc+
dataset.composition: 41 from the VulnLoc benchmark + 12 from Shariffdeen et al. (CrashRepair) = 53; 13 could not be localized, leaving 40 evaluated
dataset.note: The 'RED-TEAM-*' rows in Table 2 are the 12 CrashRepair additions. All six of those present in our dataset (jasper CVE-2020-27828, CVE-2021-3272; libtiff CVE-2018-18557, CVE-2022-4645, CVE-2022-48281; libxml2 CVE-2016-1833) are exactly our C/C++ cases that are NOT in VulnLoc.

baselines._note: b of a/b = plausible, a = correct. NMT baselines were evaluated on a 36-case subset (3 excluded for fix-location extraction).

localization_quality.note: Of the 22 with correct function-level localization, 19 got correct hunk predictions -> 12 correct patches. Of the 21 with incorrect hunk locations, only 3 correct patches. Localization quality dominates the result.

timing: Median plausible patch in 14.51 min; 92.59% within one hour; max 199 min. Failing cases dominate the tail (all three iterations run).

per_case._reason: Table 2 is a dense 12-column glyph matrix at small size; per-case transcription from the PDF is too error-prone to trust. The authors publish their generated patches and datasets at the repo — pull per-case results from baselines/vendor/looprepair/ after setup.sh, not from the PDF.
per_case._action: common/build_case_map.py leaves looprepair per-case fields null until this is filled from the repo.
